name: nvaex-burn
description: Turns weekly usage that would expire unspent into pre-approved jobs: warns, suggests, starts only what you marked auto, and brakes before the limit.

queueFile.title: Burn queue file
queueFile.description: Path to your burn-queue.json (absolute, or relative to the session's folder). Empty: ~/.nvaex/burn-queue.json.

webhookUrl.title: Webhook URL
webhookUrl.description: Optional. Each nag is POSTed here as plain text (an ntfy.sh topic URL works, so do Telegram-bridge or automation webhooks). Empty: none.

appNotify.title: Notify through Claude
appNotify.description: Raise each nag as a native notification through your own notification channel.

minLeftPercent.title: Minimum share of the week left
minLeftPercent.description: Below this % of the weekly limit left, nothing nags.

brakeFiveHour.title: Brake at 5-hour %
brakeFiveHour.description: While a burn job runs, wind it down once the 5-hour window reaches this %.

brakeWeekly.title: Brake at weekly %
brakeWeekly.description: While a burn job runs, wind it down once the weekly window reaches this %.
